nodes.summary: The Coxeter number $h$ of a Coxeter type is the largest of its degrees, and $0$ if its list of degrees is empty.
nodes.title: Coxeter number

nodes.summary: The labels $A_n$, $B_n$, $D_n$ and $I_2(m)$ for natural numbers $n$ and $m$, together with $E_6$, $E_7$, $E_8$, $F_4$, $H_3$ and $H_4$. Every natural number parameter is allowed here; the classification of irreducible finite Coxeter groups uses $A_n$ ($n \ge 1$), $B_n$ ($n \ge 2$), $D_n$ ($n \ge 4$), the six exceptional labels and the dihedral types $I_2(m)$ ($m \ge 3$).
nodes.title: Types of irreducible finite Coxeter groups

nodes.summary: The list of degrees $d_1, \dots, d_r$ of the basic invariants of a Coxeter type (so $d_i = e_i + 1$ for the exponents $e_i$) is: $2, 3, \dots, n + 1$ for $A_n$; $2, 4, \dots, 2n$ for $B_n$; $n, 2, 4, \dots, 2n - 2$ for $D_n$; $2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 12$ for $E_6$; $2, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 18$ for $E_7$; $2, 8, 12, 14, 18, 20, 24, 30$ for $E_8$; $2, 6, 8, 12$ for $F_4$; $2, 6, 10$ for $H_3$; $2, 12, 20, 30$ for $H_4$; and…
nodes.title: Degrees of the irreducible finite Coxeter groups

nodes.summary: A Coxeter type is valid when it lies in the parameter range of the classification of irreducible finite Coxeter groups: $A_n$ is valid when $n \ge 1$, $B_n$ when $n \ge 2$, $D_n$ when $n \ge 4$ and $I_2(m)$ when $m \ge 3$, while $E_6$, $E_7$, $E_8$, $F_4$, $H_3$ and $H_4$ are always valid.
nodes.title: Valid Coxeter types

nodes.summary: For a natural number $a$, the $q$-integer is the integer polynomial $[a]_q = 1 + q + \dots + q^{a-1} = \sum_{i=0}^{a-1} q^i$; in particular $[0]_q = 0$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
